name: Semantic HTML extraction protocol
description: This bilingual French/English dataset archives Semantic HTML extraction protocol v1.2.0, published by Edikka on 20 September 2026. Twelve synthetic HTML fixtures form three controlled families: native headings versus styled generic elements; table header cells with scope versus data cells; and an essential caveat in a paragraph versus an aside. Visible text and surrounding markup are held constant within each pair except for the declared treatment. Language variants are not counted as independent replications. Seven pinned tools run twice on identical input bytes: Mozilla Readability 0.6.0, Trafilatura 2.2.0, readability-lxml 0.8.4.1, newspaper4k 0.9.3.1, jusText 3.0.2, html2text 2025.4.15 and markdownify 1.2.2. Five extraction/readability tools and two Markdown converters are described separately. Expected relationships, fixtures, native outputs, observations, hashes and standalone reproduction code are included. A descriptive addendum archives eight complete Edikka page snapshots captured on 11 September 2026. All eight come from one publisher; this convenience sample is neither representative of the Web nor a causal comparison. A newspaper4k replay instability on one English page is retained. Separate evidence records one scripted keyboard interaction with DOM and accessibility-tree observations before and after JavaScript execution. This is not an autonomous-agent benchmark or a rendered-crawl experiment.
